• For the week ending September 23:
    • The price at the Title Transfer Facility (TTF) in Europe averaged $25.15/MMBtu, $2.11 lower than the previous week.
    • The Japan-Korea Marker (JKM) price averaged $26.41/MMBtu, 97 cents higher than the previous week.
    • EU gas inventories were 70% full as of September 23 compared with the five-year (2021–2025) average of 86%, according to Gas Infrastructure Europe. European natural gas inventories are a key determinant of LNG prices for the upcoming winter.
